description: This PHP source file defines the 'EmployeeLeaveEntitlementUsageReport' class within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. The class implements functionality to generate a report on employee leave entitlement and usage, including method definitions for retrieving report headers, filters, data, validation rules, and access control logic. The file includes multiple traits and interacts with different parts of the OrangeHRM API, Report, and Leave modules.

classes.name: EmployeeLeaveEntitlementUsageReport
classes.description: A class responsible for generating employee leave entitlement and usage reports within the OrangeHRM system, implementing methods for report header, filter, data retrieval, validation, and access control.

methods.name: getHeaderDefinition
methods.description: Returns the report header configuration, defining columns for leave type, entitlement, pending approval, scheduled, taken, and balance days.

methods.name: getFilterDefinition
methods.description: Returns an empty filter object as default filter configuration.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Fetches the report data based on the provided filter parameters.

methods.name: prepareFilterParams
methods.description: Prepares filtering parameters for the report based on request data, including employee number, date range, and report type.

methods.name: getValidationRule
methods.description: Provides validation rules for request parameters, including employee number and date range, with sorting and pagination rules.

methods.name: checkReportAccessibility
methods.description: Verifies if the current user has permission to access the report and that the leave period is defined.
